# 是正アクションレポート: localty-system-gui / develop

## エグゼクティブサマリ

`localty-system-gui` は、Localty ロボットを UDP 制御、UDP Discovery、UDP Telemetry、GStreamer 映像で操作・監視する PyQt6 GUI アプリケーションです。現時点のリポジトリは、初期運用に必要なドキュメント、純粋ロジックの一部分離、Discovery / Telemetry / Watchdog のユニットテストを備えており、基盤としては良い状態です。

最も重要な是正テーマは、実行時サービスが `MainWindow()` の生成時に直接起動している点です。手動運用では簡単ですが、GUI smoke test が UDP / GStreamer を起動してしまい、CI 化、障害切り分け、安全停止の証跡化が難しくなっています。短期的には `MainWindow(auto_start_services=False)` のような起動制御を導入し、その後 `VideoSession`、`RobotControlSession`、`DiscoveryService`、`TelemetryService` へ段階的に分離するのが最も効果的です。

## 検査範囲

- 対象リポジトリ: `C:\github\localty-system-gui`
- 対象ブランチ: `develop`
- 対象コミット: `526358ab021d1a516dc06b07658eca7d63f4db89`
- Remote: `https://github.com/inabako/localty-system-gui.git`
- 作業ツリー状態: `git status --short` 上は変更なし
- 確認対象:
  - `docs`
  - `src/localty_gui`
  - `src/tests`
  - `scripts`
  - `pyproject.toml`
  - `pytest.ini`
  - `.gitignore`
  - `main.spec`
- 実行した確認:
  - `.\.venv\bin\python.exe -m pytest -q src\tests\unit`: 51 passed
  - `.\.venv\bin\python.exe -m compileall -q src\localty_gui`: 出力なしで成功
- 実行しなかった確認:
  - `src/tests` 全体実行。理由は、現状の Qt smoke test が `MainWindow()` 生成時に GStreamer / UDP を起動し、Windows で access violation ログが出る可能性がドキュメント化されているため。

## リポジトリ状態

プロジェクトは比較的コンパクトで、以下の構成が確認できました。

- `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/operations.md`, `docs/testing.md`, `docs/roadmap.md`, `docs/README.md`

- `src/localty_gui/controls/logic/*`: 分離済みの純粋ロジック
- `src/tests/unit/*`: Discovery / Telemetry / Watchdog のユニットテスト
- `src/tests/qt/test_main_window_smoke.py`: GUI 生成 smoke test
- `scripts/run/*`, `scripts/test/*`: MSYS2 / Linux セットアップとテスト補助

## Findings

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CAR-001 | high | Testability / runtime boundary | `MainWindow()` starts discovery UDP, telemetry UDP, GStreamer receiver, `RobotController`, watchdog, and timers during construction. | GUI construction is coupled to external I/O. This makes smoke tests fragile, complicates CI, and makes failures harder to isolate from UI rendering. | Add `MainWindow(auto_start_services: bool = True)` and move service startup into `_start_services()`. Use `False` in smoke tests, then separate real I/O tests with an integration marker. |
| CAR-002 | high | Safety / operational evidence | Shutdown sends `VIDEO_STOP`, `set_stop()`, and `drive_zero()`, but there is no automated or documented evidence that the robot actually reaches safe stop after disconnect/close. | For robot operation, operator trust depends on verified STOP behavior, especially during GUI close, disconnect, control loss, or recovery. | Add a STOP behavior verification checklist and tests/fakes around shutdown command ordering. Capture real robot stop confirmation logs in RAG/report artifacts. |
| CAR-003 | medium | Architecture / responsibility boundaries | `MainWindow` still owns UI, discovery, telemetry parsing, video lifecycle, control lifecycle, watchdog display, recovery, and logging. | Changes to one runtime concern can affect unrelated GUI behavior. The current design also makes field issue triage harder. | Follow the existing roadmap: introduce `VideoSession`, `RobotControlSession`, `DiscoveryService`, `TelemetryService`, then `ConnectionCoordinator`. |
| CAR-004 | medium | Configuration consistency | Port/host defaults are partly centralized in `ConstWidgets`, but `MainWindow` still hardcodes `5700`, `5600`, `5010`, `5011`, `5006`, `5005`, and `5000`; `ConstNetwork.TELEMETRY_PORT = 5007` also diverges from FAST/SLOW telemetry ports. | Port drift across GUI, robot, protocol, docs, and tests can cause silent integration failures. | Consolidate network constants into one authoritative module and update docs/tests from that module or a shared schema. Remove or replace stale `ConstNetwork.TELEMETRY_PORT`. |
| CAR-005 | medium | Observability / video reliability | `GstVideoReceiver` starts a GStreamer pipeline and pumps GLib, but there is no explicit bus error/EOS handling. | Video loss, caps mismatch, plugin errors, or decoder failures may only appear as stale frames, making field diagnosis slow. | Attach a GStreamer bus watch, emit structured error/EOS stats, and document common error signatures in operations/RAG. |
| CAR-006 | medium | CI / workflow readiness | No `.github` workflows are present. Docs recommend unit-only CI initially, but the automation is not implemented. | Passing local tests are useful, but regression protection depends on automated execution on branches/PRs. | Add a minimal CI workflow that installs test dependencies and runs `src/tests/unit`; keep Qt/GStreamer integration out until service startup is injectable. |
| CAR-007 | medium | Documentation correctness | `docs/README.md` references old document names (`spec_program.md`, `spec_ops.md`, `spec_test.md`, `brain_dump.md`) that do not match the current files. | Agents and humans following the index will look for missing documents, reducing RAG usefulness and onboarding reliability. | Update the docs index to point to `architecture.md`, `operations.md`, `testing.md`, and `roadmap.md`. |
| CAR-008 | medium | Maintainability / RAG quality | Source comments and some UI/log strings still contain mojibake. | Corrupted text reduces maintainability, operator clarity, and future RAG retrieval quality. | Fix encoding-corrupted comments and user-visible strings, prioritizing `main_window.py`, `robot_controller.py`, `command_mapper.py`, `telemetry.py`, and test comments. |
| CAR-009 | low | Dependency / packaging clarity | `pyproject.toml` has empty required dependencies and a `gui` optional extra, while setup scripts rely on MSYS2 `pacman` and `--no-deps`. | This may be intentional for MSYS2/GStreamer stability, but package consumers can misread the install contract. | Document the dependency model directly in root-level README or pyproject metadata, and clarify when `gui` extras are useful versus when pacman packages are required. |
| CAR-010 | info | Local generated artifacts | `.venv` and `.pytest_cache` exist in the working tree but are ignored by `.gitignore`. | This is acceptable locally, but recursive scans can become noisy and slow if agents do not exclude ignored/generated paths. | Keep generated artifacts ignored; add agent/report guidance to scope scans to `docs`, `src`, `scripts`, and config files. |

# Corrective Action Report: localty-system-gui / develop

## Executive Summary

`localty-system-gui` is a PyQt6 GUI for operating and monitoring the Localty robot over UDP control, UDP discovery, UDP telemetry, and GStreamer video. The repository is in a useful early-operational state: documentation is present, core pure logic is separated in part, and unit tests for discovery, telemetry parsing, and watchdog behavior pass.

The main corrective theme is that runtime services still start directly from `MainWindow()`. That keeps manual operation simple, but it makes GUI tests start UDP and GStreamer, weakens CI readiness, and makes safety/rollback evidence harder to collect. The highest-value next step is to introduce a service-start control such as `MainWindow(auto_start_services=False)`, then move video, control, discovery, and telemetry into explicit services over time.

## Inspection Scope

- Repository path: `C:\github\localty-system-gui`
- Branch: `develop`
- Commit: `526358ab021d1a516dc06b07658eca7d63f4db89`
- Remote: `https://github.com/inabako/localty-system-gui.git`
- Worktree status: clean by `git status --short`
- Reviewed areas: `docs`, `src/localty_gui`, `src/tests`, `scripts`, `pyproject.toml`, `pytest.ini`, `.gitignore`, `main.spec`

  - Full `src/tests` suite, because project documentation notes the Qt smoke test starts GStreamer/UDP and may emit Windows access violation logs even when passed.

## 1. 現状サマリ

`localty-system-gui` は PyQt6 ベースのロボット操作GUIで、UDP制御、UDP Discovery、Telemetry受信、GStreamer映像受信を1つのデスクトップアプリとしてまとめている。

現在の環境確認では、MSYS2 MINGW64 上の Python 実行環境、PyQt6、numpy、gi、GStreamer、`localty-system-protocol` の editable install は整っている。VSCodeのインタプリタも `.venv` に向ける設定へ更新済み。

テスト状況は以下の通り。

- unit test: 成功
- full test: `52 passed` だが、Qt/GStreamerを含む smoke test 実行時に `Windows fatal exception: access violation` のログが出る
- GStreamer plugin確認: `udpsrc` と `h264parse` は使用可能

作業ツリー状態:

- `.vscode/settings.json` に未コミット変更あり

## 2. 優先度高の改善案

### 2.1 MainWindowの責務を分割する

対象:

- `src/localty_gui/widgets/main_window.py`

現状、`MainWindow` が以下を同時に担当している。

- UI構築
- Discovery UDPソケット管理
- Telemetry FAST/SLOW受信
- GStreamer映像受信の起動/再起動
- ロボット制御の起動/再起動
- watchdog判定のUI反映
- 自動復旧処理
- 接続/切断フロー

ファイルサイズも約35KBと大きく、テスト時に `MainWindow()` を生成するだけで通信・映像受信・タイマーが起動する。このため、単体テストとGUIスモークテストの境界が曖昧になっている。

改善案:

- `ConnectionManager`: 接続/切断/再接続/VIDEO_TARGET送信を担当
- `DiscoveryService`: UDP Discovery受信とロボット一覧管理を担当
- `TelemetryService`: FAST/SLOW telemetry受信と値の正規化を担当
- `VideoSession`: GStreamer receiverの start/stop/restart を担当
- `MainWindow`: UI配置とシグナル接続に集中

期待効果:

- GUI生成だけで外部通信が始まらない構成にできる
- mock差し替えが簡単になり、Qtテストが安定する
- 接続復旧ロジックを単体テストしやすくなる

### 2.2 Qt smoke testを外部I/Oから切り離す

対象:

- `src/tests/qt/test_main_window_smoke.py`
- `src/localty_gui/widgets/main_window.py`
